g.text: Dashboard, In-System, Install, Update, Maintenance, History (its menu), Help (its menu)
the underlined letter in the menu bar: D, I, N, U, M, S (History), H (Help)
open Update · on Update: update the ticked ones
open Maintenance · on Maintenance: clean up the ticked categories
check for updates · on Maintenance: look again
the row's option: install, remove, promote; on nog Logs: open the log
tick or untick an update · on Maintenance: a category
leave a field, close a window
quit (not there inside hypeForge Settings: Settings closes nogForge)
